clearer_why: In A every arrow has its own line with its label sitting right on it (verify, browse, checkout; session/cache; card, settled, placed), so it is unambiguous where each goes. In B, verify/browse share one trunk, settled and card leave Payments on a shared line with labels side by side, and the dashed 'placed' edge loops out left across the Checkout core boundary, which makes it hard to tell which label belongs to which arrow.

weak_A: tall and sparse; needs scrolling across two images
weak_B: shared trunks and loose labels make edges ambiguous (placed/settled/card, verify/browse)
